detail.longDescription: I’m still astonished that we don’t all learn about this as kids. And that we need a research study to make it culturally visible. It’s basic hygiene. I love Japanese bidet seats & wish ours had an automatic lid. Why are these not everywhere! Esp in aged care & health care settings. So much easier & cleaner for everyone. If I must use a public toilet I wear a mask. Never use an electric hand dryer. Wash hands, dry using paper if available then use hand sanitizer after leaving the room. This all seems so obvious to me. Not everyone is as healthy as we are & what we do affects others. Do we care? # hygiene # toilet # flush # research # accessibility https://www. theguardian.com/australia-news /2026/sep/09/flushing-the-toilet-releases-pathogens-inhaled?CMP=Share_iOSApp_Other
